sloka: तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तेषां राक्षसेन्द्रो महाबलः ।चिन्ताशोकसमाक्रान्तो विषण्णवदनो ऽब्रवीत् ।। ६.५१.१४ ।।।।
transliteration: tacchrutvā vacanaṁ teṣāṁ rākṣasendro mahābalaḥ ।cintāśokasamākrānto viṣaṇṇavadano 'bravīt ।। 6.51.14 ।।।।

translations.english: "The two brothers, Rama and Lakshmana, who are like powerful elephants have been set free from the bondage of arrows of Indrajith in the battlefield. Their shoulders are relieved and are like elephants snapped off the rope binding them."
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी और लक्ष्मण जी के शरीरो को बाणों र णों से बिधा हुआ देख, धर्मात्मा विभीषण बहुत विकल हुए
